issues.detail: Appendix 3(a) 2024 t/ha column does not match tonnes (P96A 29.11 t/ha for 611.6 t; P10C 7.78 for 150.56 t). 2021 P04B 21.09 and P02E 17.38 vs PA 18.61 and 19.26.

issues.title: Trap check
issues.detail: PA 'same period' 784.69 t is real Jan–Apr 2025 actual; '12 months' 2,556.86 t covers Jan–Dec 2025 (matches monthly sum). Agro 2/2025 Jan–Oct 2025 2,042.73 t is labelled TOTAL 2025 in Appendix 3 (10 months only) — not used as full year. No combined estates (manager and accounts shared with Sungai Batu only).

actions.item: Recruit an additional 5 TKIs immediately; worker shortage is long-standing
Get help from Ladang Sungai Batu or sister estates to clear upkeep, pruning and manuring backlog
Clear pruning backlog by June, highest-yield fields first, replant fields last
Skilled cutters to cut fronds and ripe bunches only; less skilled workers to stack fronds
Palm-base raking in tall-palm areas to remove frond butts and debris
Road grading before June / end-May ahead of peak crop
Plant beneficial plants: Cassia, Antigonon, Turnera 60:20:20 in clumps 50–100 m apart (no progress in 4 months)
Apply 2026 fertiliser now (none applied by Apr); coordinate with Sungai Batu; ask Agronomist about combining applications
Complete delayed circle spraying; keep Glyphosate to 2 m radius
Spot-spray or poison sporadic tough jungle woodies
Census and mark Ganoderma palms; de-bole fallen stumps
Keep regular rat and bagworm census
Raise tractor and Timac use from 5.60 to 8 hours a day
Monitor worker productivity and earnings to keep skilled workers
Do not leave harvested bunches or fertiliser bags overnight at the boundary; regular patrols
Complete first NK1 and Mix B application (due Feb) by April 2026
Expedite pruning, catch up P04B, P10C, P98D, P06G; deal with super-tall palms left unharvested
Quarterly rat damage census
Clean and maintain barn owl boxes
Annual Ganoderma monitoring and deboling
Follow-up leaf sampling in 2026 (N, Mg, B sub-optimal in 2025)
Monitor weeds and intervene early by hand removal or targeted herbicide
Complete the whole 2026 fertiliser programme on schedule
2025 fertiliser programme incl. pending Mix B completed (Nov 2025)
Withdraw fertiliser for P96A, P98D, P02E ahead of 2027 replanting
Bagworm post-treatment census (trunk injection effective)
Replant 58.30 ha in 2027 with Yangambi Platinum clones (material reserved with Felda)

kb:
LADANG SUNGAI RASAU - FACT PACK (Far East Holdings Berhad, Far East group). Deputy Chief Operating Officer / Plantation Controller En. Nazaruddin Bin Hashim. Manager En. Ahmad Khairul Hakim Bin Mohamad, who also manages Ladang Sungai Batu; supervisor Wan Mohd Nor Bin Wan Mohd Rozman. Estate accounts are prepared by Sungai Batu clerks.

SOURCES. (1) PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisory), visit 21 May 2026, period reviewed January to April 2026, Planting Advisor En. Mohd Sufian Bin Yusoff; last PA visit 20 November 2025 by Tuan Haji Abdullah Bin Busu Hanifah (PA 2/2025, Jan-Oct 2025). (2) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 22 April 2026, Junior Agronomist En. Muhammad Ghazali Abdul Ghani and Senior Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming; last visit 27 November 2025 (Agronomy 2/2025, which drew up the 2026 programme).

AREA (PA 1/2026, Apr 2026). Total 118.04 ha: mature oil palm 111.00 ha (94.04%), building 1.00 ha, unplantable 6.04 ha. No immature or replanting area. Fields: P96A 27.20 ha (1996, DxP HRU, SPH 128), P04B 15.00 (2004, Felda, 119), P10C 4.60 (2010, 141), P98D 12.60 (1998, 139), P02E 18.50 (2002, 133), P05F 20.60 (2005, 144), P06G 12.50 (2006, 142); average SPH 134. Age profile 4% prime, 96% old mature above 20 years. Flat, suited to mechanisation. Five-year average rainfall 2,900 mm over 120 days, mostly Oct-Jan. Agro census SPH: P96A 118, P04B 135, P10C 135, P98D 122, P02E 132, P05F 136, P06G 145. Replanting: P96A, P98D and P02E, 58.30 ha (53% of estate), in 2027 with Yangambi Platinum clonal material, reserved with Felda; fertiliser for these blocks withdrawn in 2026.

CROP (PA 1/2026 Table 16, 111 ha). Jan-Apr 2026 FFB 800.68 t vs budget 714.00 t (+12%) and 784.69 t in Jan-Apr 2025 (+2%). Yield 7.21 t/ha vs budget 6.43 and 7.07 last year; annual budget 2,300 t (20.72 t/ha). CPO 152.13 t, OER 19.00%, KER 4.59%. 2025 full year 2,556.86 t, 23.03 t/ha. Field yields Jan-Apr 2026 (t/ha): P96A 5.05, P04B 8.75, P10C 12.80 (highest, prime), P98D 9.12, P02E 6.48, P05F 5.77, P06G 9.59. Jan-Apr 2025 for comparison (PA Table 18 column mislabelled Budget 2026): 6.37, 5.80, 8.40, 6.84, 6.89, 8.86, 7.18. Bunches per palm 2.72 and average bunch weight 18.97 kg estate. PA expects over 20 t/ha in 2026. Agro: Jan-Mar 2026 5.92 t/ha vs 5.08 in 2025 (+16.6%) in Table 15, but its Appendix shows 569.55 t = 5.13 t/ha; production trend declining in P96A, P02E, P05F due to labour shortage.

YIELD HISTORY (t/ha, PA Table 18 / Agro App 2a): 2021 19.12, 2022 19.03, 2023 19.71, 2024 24.89, 2025 23.03. Tonnes: 2019 2,749.41; 2020 2,601.17; 2021 2,122.72; 2022 2,111.90; 2023 2,188.23; 2024 2,762.24; 2025 2,556.86. Monthly 2025 (t): Jan 193.01, Feb 176.22, Mar 204.11, Apr 211.35, May 181.32, Jun 181.50, Jul 184.30, Aug 203.26, Sep 204.31, Oct 303.35, Nov 300.09, Dec 214.04. 2026: Jan 217.64, Feb 189.26, Mar 162.65. Block 2025 t/ha: P96A 18.96, P04B 24.05, P10C 32.42, P98D 19.67, P02E 23.41, P05F 25.72, P06G 25.65.

COST (PA 1/2026, Jan-Apr 2026). Ex-estate RM197.49/t FFB vs budget RM341.75 (-42%); annual budget RM324.01. General charges RM90.26 (budget 148.34), upkeep RM23.10 (107.73), harvesting and collection RM84.14 (85.67): harvesting RM55.02 (60.67), internal transport RM29.12 (25.00). The PA warns the low upkeep cost comes from delayed field work and may cost more later to clear backlogs. General charges RM72,266.40 = RM651.05/ha vs RM954.20 (-32%); overspent non-executive salaries (Sungai Batu clerks' share) +64%, non-exec travelling +30%, entertainment +20% (Hari Raya), MSPO +125% (signboards). Upkeep RM18,494 = RM166.61/ha vs RM692.97: weeding 53.73 (91.53), manuring nil (286.41), pest and disease 17.07 (91.06), drains 16.93 (37.55), roads 57.65 (107.17), boundaries 2.59 (5.37), pruning 18.64 (67.50). PA 2/2025: Jan-Oct 2025 cost RM253.84/t vs RM299.27.

LABOUR (PA 1/2026, Apr 2026). 7 workers vs requirement 11 (short 4): harvesting 5 (req 5), driver/loader 1 (2), weeding 0 (1), manuring 0 (2), security 1 (1). Ratio 1 worker to 16 ha. 1 TKI repatriated and 1 absconded in four months. Recruit 5 more TKIs immediately; seek help from Sungai Batu. Agro: worker restructuring; several workers went home without renewing permits. PA 2/2025 had 9 workers vs 10.

HARVESTING. Average interval 15 days, 7.93 rounds Jan-Apr 2026 (Table 14 average 7.57). 5 harvesters with 1 Timac; harvester output 1.58 to 2.80 t/man-day (P98D best, P05F lowest), average 1.93 t (Table 14) or 2.39 t (Table 19); Timac 8.08 t/day. Rate RM39.00/t; earnings RM61.62-109.20/day, average RM75.27. FFB quality satisfactory, dispatched within 24 hours. Agro: super-tall palms (over 50 ft) with skirting fronds in P96A and P98D are very hard to harvest; some palms left unattended. Rounds 2025: 23-25 per field.

MANURING. 2025: NK1 47.01 t, Mix B 56.04 t, RP 11.30 t, total 114.35 t, 100% applied, completed Nov 2025 after supplier delays on Mix B. 2026 to April: required 41.80 t (Feb NK1 4.30, Feb Mix B 11.25, Apr RP 11.15, May NK1 10.00, May Mix B 5.10), delivered 36.70 t, nothing applied; application started May 2026. 3 workers and 1 Badang can apply 5 t a day.

2026 FERTILISER PROGRAMME (Agro 1/2026 Appendix 1, revised, grams per palm). P04B: NK1 2,000 Feb, RP 1,500 Apr, NK1 2,000 May, NK1 2,000 Aug. P05F: Mix B 2,000 Feb, RP 1,500 Apr, NK1 2,000 May, Mix B 2,000 Aug. P06G: Mix B 2,250 Feb, RP 1,500 Apr, Mix B 2,000 May, Mix B 2,000 Aug. P10C: Mix B 2,250 Feb, RP 1,500 Apr, Mix B 2,250 May, Mix B 1,500 Jul, Mix B 1,500 Oct. P96A, P98D, P02E: none (replant 2027). The Nov 2025 draft had Jul and Oct rounds instead of Aug. 2027 programme to be drawn up after the second-half visit. 2025 programme (Agro 2/2024): P96A and P98D <NK1 2,000> Mar and Sep; P02E NK1 2,500 Feb, Jun, Sep; P04B Mix B 2,250 Feb and May, RP 1,500 Apr, NK1 2,000 Aug and Nov; P05F, P06G, P10C Mix B 2,000-2,250 in Feb, May, Jul, Oct plus RP 1,500-1,750 Apr.

LEAF NUTRIENTS. May 2025 samples (Agro 2/2025): N deficient in P10C, P02E, P06G (2.46-2.47%), moderately low in P04B and P05F; K high (1.08-1.22%) everywhere; Mg moderately low to deficient (0.22-0.23%); B 10.25-11.25 ppm. Agro 1/2026: mild K deficiency symptoms in P10C, P05F and P02E; follow-up sampling in 2026.

WEEDING. Jan-Apr 2026: circle spraying 54.70 of 111.00 ha (P96A, P04B, P06G done); selective round 1 complete on 111.00 ha. Palm circles mostly clean; frond butts and debris need raking; sporadic tough woodies. Agro to Mar 2026: inter-row round 1 done everywhere; circle done except P98D, P02E, P05F; no over-spraying. Sprayer output 6.50 ha/day circle, 5.00 ha/day selective.

PRUNING. Jan-Apr 2026: 39.87 of 111.00 ha (35.92%): P96A 5.64 ha (20.73%), P04B 0, P10C 0, P98D 3.00 (23.80%), P02E 6.23 (33.68%), P05F 20.00 (97.09%), P06G 5.00 (40%). Complete backlog by June before peak crop. Agro: under-pruning in most blocks; only P05F finished round 1 by March.

PESTS AND DISEASES. Rats: March 2026 census 0-2% fresh damage, no baiting needed; 12 barn owl boxes, 100% occupied, 1 per 9 ha. Bagworm Q1 2026 live larvae: P96A 15/6/3, P10C 18/4/2, P98D 45/15/8 (Jan/Feb/Mar); P98D trunk-injected with Impact-75 (Acephate) 20 ml per palm in March, positive result. 2025 bagworm outbreak in Q1 treated by trunk injection Apr-Sep 2025. Ganoderma census: P96A 261 palms (18 collapsed), P04B 30 (6), P10C 7, P98D 126 (14), P06G 86 (3), P02E and P05F none; monitor annually and de-bole. Beneficial plants 80 chains; no new planting in 2026 so far.

ROADS, DRAINS, VEHICLES. Rental backhoe for road patching and drains in P04B, P98D, P02E. Road grading planned end-May 2026 (not done in 2025). John Deere tractor RM7.28/hr, Timac RM10.17/hr (budget 5.60); both only about 5.60 hrs a day vs 8 target. No capital expenditure in 2026.

RAINFALL (mm, days). 2021 3,307.5/104; 2022 3,069/147; 2023 2,840/126; 2024 2,484.5/118; 2025 4,118.5/106 (Nov 1,048.5 and Dec 1,431 mm); Jan-Apr 2026 396 mm, 13 days.

KEY ACTIONS. Recruit 5 TKIs and borrow workers from Sungai Batu; apply 2026 fertiliser now; clear pruning backlog by June; complete circle spraying and raking; road grading; beneficial plants; Ganoderma census and deboling; quarterly rat census; leaf sampling 2026; prepare 2027 replanting of 58.30 ha.
